name: Google Cloud Vision
tagline: Google Cloud image analysis API for labels, OCR, faces, landmarks, and more
description: Google Cloud Vision API detects objects, faces, text, landmarks, logos, and safe-search attributes in images via REST and client libraries. It supports feature detection on local or remote images, document text (OCR), and batch annotation, typically authenticated with a Google Cloud API key or service account and billed per feature unit.

auth.details: API key as query param key=YOUR_API_KEY (or OAuth2/service-account Bearer token). Enable Cloud Vision API in a GCP project; self-serve via Google Cloud Console.

pricing.free_tier_limits: First 1,000 units/month free per feature (label, OCR, face, etc.); web detection 1,000 free; storage/document features have separate free allotments — confirm current pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go after free tier; pricing varies by feature (e.g. Label Detection, Text Detection, Face Detection billed per image unit)

rate_limits: Default quotas apply per project (e.g. requests per minute); exact defaults vary and are configurable in GCP Console Quotas — see Cloud Vision quotas docs
use_cases: detect objects and labels in an uploaded product photo
extract printed or handwritten text (OCR) from an image or PDF page
detect faces and approximate emotions in a photo
flag adult or violent content with Safe Search detection
recognize landmarks or logos in user-uploaded images
